about: GTA 6 costs $79.99 (US Standard, PS Store + Xbox Store, checked 2026-11-07). GTA 5 was $59.99 at its Sept 17 2013 US launch (Kotaku, 9to5Toys, May 23 2013). BLS CPI-U all items, US city average, NSA: Sept 2013 234.149, Sept 2026 336.940, ratio 1.4390, so $59.99 then = $86.33 in Sept 2026 dollars: over $85, more than GTA 6's $79.99. Delta, pillar 1.

lines.say: G T A 6 costs eighty dollars. Too much?
